Online stores and portals

narrative.overview: The site reads like a well-made company operations manual for a small business. Paper-white pages sit on a cool grey desk. Each service is a chapter, marked by a coloured index tab the way real divider stock is, and the cover shows work routing itself between the tools a business already has.
keyCharacteristics: Paper on a desk: white page bands alternate with grey desk bands.
Four index-tab colours, tinted from the logo, one per service chapter, never decorative.
Expanded grotesk display type with tight tracking; plain workhorse body.
Mono only for data: times, prices, phone numbers, revisions, field and spec labels.
Solid lines mean automated; dashed lines mean done by hand.

rules.name: The Logo Palette Rule
rules.body: New colour comes from the K or it does not come in. The tab stocks are tints of the logo; the logo itself is never recoloured, outlined or flattened to one colour.

rules.name: The One Tab, One Chapter Rule
rules.body: A tab colour appears only where its chapter is meant. Never as decoration or emphasis.

rules.name: The Tinted Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on a tab colour is ink mixed toward that tab, never grey.

rules.name: The Assembling Letters Rule
rules.body: Display and headline text may decode into place once; real text is always in the HTML first and reduced motion skips it.

rules.name: The Data-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono is for times, prices, phone numbers, revisions, counts and labels.

rules.name: The Real Paper Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from soft offset shadows and real 3D only. No bevels, embossing or faked materials.

dos: Do give each service its tab colour everywhere it appears, and nowhere else.
Do draw automated paths solid and manual paths dashed.
Do render real text first and animate on top of it. Every effect has a static state.
Do keep primary actions ink, or yellow on the ink panel.
Do label demonstration data as an example, and keep client facts to what was actually built.
donts: Don't use cream or warm paper. The page is cool white (#fcfcfd) on a cool desk (#e9ebef).
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings, gradient text, glass, or neon glows.
Don't fake material with bevels, embossing or inset shadows.
Don't set headings or paragraphs in mono.
Don't build sections out of equal grids of icon cards. Use contents lists, spec sheets, divider sheets and case files.
